import importlib.util,json,os,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();base=root/'build/tornread/instructions-20261109-110708';out=root/'build/tornhold/instruction-diagnostics'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('instrument',root/'tools/tornread_instructions.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
original_popen=m.subprocess.Popen;original_info=m.info_fields
observations=[]
def popen(args,*a,**kw):
 if isinstance(args,list) and args[:2]==['perf','stat']:
  args=list(args);args[args.index('-e')+1]='instructions:u,cycles:u,task-clock,context-switches,cpu-migrations'
 return original_popen(args,*a,**kw)
def info(conn):
 row=original_info(conn);pid=int(row['process_id']);threads=[]
 for path in sorted((Path('/proc')/str(pid)/'task').iterdir()):
  try:
   raw=(path/'stat').read_text();a=raw[raw.rfind(')')+2:].split();status=(path/'status').read_text().splitlines()
   threads.append(dict(tid=int(path.name),user_ticks=int(a[11]),system_ticks=int(a[12]),cpu=int(a[36]),affinity=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(int(path.name))),context_switches={line.split(':')[0]:int(line.split(':')[1]) for line in status if line.startswith(('voluntary_ctxt_switches:','nonvoluntary_ctxt_switches:'))}))
  except OSError:pass
 observations.append(dict(info=row,threads=threads))
 return row
m.subprocess.Popen=popen;m.info_fields=info
cases=[('2s',0,'GET',1,'part2'),('2s',0,'GET',1,'pre'),('2s',0,'MSET',8,'hold'),('2s',0,'MSET',8,'pre'),('2s',1,'GET',1,'hold'),('2s',1,'GET',1,'pre'),('2s',1,'SET',32,'hold'),('2s',1,'SET',32,'pre'),('2s',0,'GET',32,'hold'),('2s',0,'GET',32,'pre'),('1s',0,'GET',32,'hold'),('1s',0,'GET',32,'pre')]
records=[]
for rep in range(5):
 for mode,atomic,verb,depth,arm in (cases if rep%2==0 else list(reversed(cases))):
  folder=out/f'{mode}-a{atomic}-{verb}-p{depth}-{arm}-r{rep}';observations.clear()
  row=m.cell(root/f'build/tornread/tomokv-{arm}',folder,base/'seed.tomo',mode,atomic,verb,depth,65536,8,True,26595)
  row.update(arm=arm,repeat=rep,observations=observations.copy(),extra_counter_events='cycles:u,task-clock,context-switches,cpu-migrations')
  (folder/'diagnostic.json').write_text(json.dumps(row,indent=2)+'\n')
  records.append({k:v for k,v in row.items() if k!='observations'})
  (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(folder.name,round(row['instructions_per_op'],2),flush=True)

import importlib.util,json,os,select,signal,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'build/tornhold/instruction-profiles-controlled';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
seed=root/'build/tornread/instructions-20261109-110708/seed.tomo'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('instrument',root/'tools/tornread_instructions.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
original_popen=m.subprocess.Popen;original_write=os.write;profiler=None;folder=None;record_control=None;record_ack=None;record_fds=[]
def record_command(message):
 original_write(record_control,message)
 assert select.select([record_ack],[],[],10)[0],'record control timeout'
 assert os.read(record_ack,64).rstrip(b'\0')==b'ack\n'
def write(fd,data):
 if record_control is not None and fd!=record_control and data==b'enable\n':record_command(data)
 n=original_write(fd,data)
 if record_control is not None and fd!=record_control and data==b'disable\n':record_command(data)
 return n
def popen(args,*a,**kw):
 global profiler,record_control,record_ack,record_fds
 if isinstance(args,list) and args[:2]==['perf','stat']:
  pid=args[args.index('-p')+1];ctl_r,ctl_w=os.pipe();ack_r,ack_w=os.pipe();record_fds=[ctl_r,ctl_w,ack_r,ack_w];record_control=ctl_w;record_ack=ack_r
  log=(folder/'record.log').open('w')
  profiler=original_popen(['taskset','-c','16-19','perf','record','-D','-1','--control',f'fd:{ctl_r},{ack_w}','-e','instructions:u','-F','997','-p',pid,'-o',str(folder/'perf.data')],pass_fds=(ctl_r,ack_w),stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  log.close();record_command(b'enable\n');record_command(b'disable\n')
 return original_popen(args,*a,**kw)
m.subprocess.Popen=popen;m.os.write=write
records=[]
for arm,depth in [('pre',1),('part2',1),('hold',1),('pre',32),('part2',32),('hold',32)]:
 folder=out/f'2s-a0-GET-p{depth}-{arm}'
 row=m.cell(root/f'build/tornread/tomokv-{arm}',folder,seed,'2s',0,'GET',depth,65536,8,True,26595)
 if profiler.poll() is None:profiler.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
 profiler.wait(timeout=15)
 record_control=None;record_ack=None
 for fd in record_fds:os.close(fd)
 row.update(arm=arm,profiling=True,profile_control_acknowledged=True)
 records.append(row);(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
 with (folder/'report.txt').open('w') as log:
  subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','16-19','perf','report','--stdio','--no-children','--sort','dso,symbol','--percent-limit','0.5','-i',str(folder/'perf.data')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 assert (folder/'perf.data').stat().st_size>0
 print(arm,depth,round(row['instructions_per_op'],2),flush=True)
